paragraphs.text: Avad was a thug who encountered Jared Carthalion in Rifa's Inn , in the town of Hamath on Corondor ( Dominaria ).
Like Daro and Gensai , Gensai had his head shaved and his body was covered by tattooes.

After mocking Jared Carthalion and calling him an illusion cast by Ravidel , Gensai witnessed the wayfarer 's anger as he cast a Hurricane spell, tearing the inn apart and causing everyone inside to flee into the streets.
